citations.assessment: The genealogy is expressed in the rooftop narrative as Chananya son of Chizkiyah son of Garon. The direct Mishnah has the related Garrion spelling.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
